title: Telemetry domain model in stratum-core

user_story.i_want: strongly typed Rust types for the telemetry envelope, categories and queue messages, with JSON (de)serialization and validation
user_story.so_that: every service shares exactly one definition of what a record is

description:
In stratum-core, model:
- `TelemetryEnvelope` (event_id UUID, source_id, name, occurred_at UTC timestamp, schema_version, attributes map, payload JSON value)
- `IngestedRecord` (envelope + tenant_id + received_at)
- the enums `DataType` (metric, event, log) and `ProductType` (web, mobile, iot, backend), serialized lowercase
- typed payloads `MetricPayload`, `EventPayload`, `LogPayload` with a `LogLevel` enum
- the queue messages `RawFileMessage` and `TransformMessage` (both carry `version`)
Add `validate()`, which returns *all* problems: empty source_id or name, name longer than 128 characters, occurred_at more than 7 days in the past or 5 minutes in the future, payload not a JSON object. Use the shapes in docs/architecture.md.

acceptance_criteria.when: it is deserialized and serialized again
acceptance_criteria.then: the JSON is equivalent and field names are snake_case
deserialization fails with an error that names the unknown variant
every problem is returned, not just the first (table-driven test with at least 6 cases)
the text form matches the JSON form exactly
all tests pass without any external service

rust_concepts: derive macros (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)
technical_notes: Pick one time crate (chrono or time) and use it everywhere; enable its serde feature.
Write validation by hand first (better learning); validator/garde crates are optional later.
